jobs.description:
This role has been designed to support alliance-wide coordination, administration, community-building activities, and events, with a particular focus on the administrative implementation, monitoring and reporting of the Una Europa Seed Funding initiative. 

Key tasks: 

• Hands-on implementation of Una Europa Seed Funding in collaboration with experienced colleagues, including support for call design, tasks related to project implementation, and acting as the first point of contact for the initiative. 
• Overseeing administrative reporting of Una Europa Seed Funding initiative with a focus on monitoring project outcomes, finances and capturing impact on engagement of Una Europa academic community, in collaboration with partner universities. 
• Liaison with operational and administrative colleagues across the Una Europa partner universities, including on coordination of meetings. 
• Support for the organisation of virtual, in-person and hybrid meetings, notably calendar coordination, minutewriting, and logistical assistance such as booking travel, room reservations, and liaison with external suppliers. 
• Administrative support for Una.Connect, Una Europa's virtual community-building platform hosted on Microsoft Teams. 
• Administrative support for projects of strategic impact at the level of the alliance, and at European level. 
• Operational support for Secretary General and other members of the Brussels team on administrative tasks.  
• Other tasks in line with the position.  
• Preferably 2 years of relevant work experience. Relevant internships, student jobs, and/or university association experience are highly valued. 
• Relevant professional experience in administration, project support or programme coordination. 
• Excellent digital skills, including command of MS Office 365 (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneNote, Excel, Word and PowerPoint). 
• Spoken and written language proficiency in English; ability to work in Dutch an advantage. 
• A proactive attitude, ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, as part of an international team. 
• Intercultural competences and skills, at ease working across different cultures. 
• Excellent organisational skills, problem solving skills and an eye for detail. 
• Interest in and affinity for higher education and European university collaboration. 
• Flexibility, enthusiasm, eagerness to learn and confidence to work across a variety of tasks.  
• Full-time contract for a duration of 2 years under Belgian law and attractive salary package in line with experience and skills. Openness to discuss flexible working arrangements. 
• Additional benefits, including extralegal holidays, meal vouchers, group insurance and hospitalisation insurance policies. 
• Collaborative work environment within an international team based at an office in the centre of Brussels, easily reachable by public transport. Remote working arrangements possible. 
• Opportunity for occasional travel within Europe (approximately 2 times per year). 
• Access to professional development and training opportunities. 
Una Europa is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone feels valued and respected. We welcome applications from individuals with diverse abilities, of any gender, linguistic and cultural background, or minority group. We encourage applications from candidates who meet most, but not necessarily all, of the listed requirements.

Are you at the beginning of your career and motivated by learning new things and developing in a professional environment? We are looking for a structured and curious person who wants to build experience in project administration, coordination and communication.

At Mercuri Urval (MU), a leading international company in Executive Search and Leadership Advisory, you will have the opportunity to become part of our office in Brussels (office location will be Zaventem as from December 1st). We work with market-leading clients and important assignments where quality in every detail is crucial. You will be part of a team where you receive a thorough introduction and continuous support, and where you gradually take on more responsibility as you develop. The role suits you who are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of experience and want a varied day-to-day work with good development opportunities.
About the role
As a Business Support Specialist at MU, you have a central and business-critical role in the daily operations. Your work directly contributes to structure, quality and an efficient implementation of our client assignments. You will be part of a support team that collaborates closely across country and office borders. We value quality, knowledge sharing, clear communication and a non-prestigious way of working together, and you will have broad contact surfaces both locally and internationally.
Examples of tasks
• Assist with ongoing administrative work, project follow-up and coordination with support from colleagues
• Assist with administrative tasks related to contracts, invoicing and internal support
• Help with coordination and publishing of job advertisements in digital channels
• Support with proofreading, simple translation
• Opportunity to develop in the role and gradually take on more responsibility over time
To succeed in the role, you are highly structured, quality-conscious and confident in a professional context. You have the ability to maintain focus even at a high pace with several parallel tasks.
 You are a person who
• has some experience in administrative, coordinating or supporting tasks, for example from a role as administrator, coordinator, assistant or similar.
• enjoys creating structure, keeping track of details and making everyday life run smoothly for others.
• has an interest in administration, processes, systems and preferably also in how ways of working can be improved and made more efficient.
• feels comfortable with Microsoft Office and other digital tools, and is curious about how AI can be used as support in daily work.
• is comfortable engaging with individuals in senior-level positions, including C-suite executives and Board members.
• communicates clearly and professionally in Dutch, French and English, both orally and in writing.
• is service-oriented, meticulous and solution-driven, with a way of working that builds trust.
• has a proactive approach, thinks out-of-the-box and can set priorities independently.
• thrives when taking responsibility for tasks, working in a structured way and delivering with quality.
• wants to continue developing in a role where you can learn a lot, grow over time and contribute to a professional environment with high ambitions. Our offer
• Employment in a global and engaging environment that promotes collaborative teamwork, human values, and where working and interacting with people is enjoyable.
• The opportunity to work with a flat, foundation-owned company that is a leader in the field of science-based human resources management and leadership advisory, both nationally and internationally.
• A cross-border team of Business Specialist colleagues who prioritise collective success over hierarchical structures.
• A small local team of ~15 kind and dynamic consultants, and many more colleagues across the globe.
• A permanent full-time contract with a salary package and extra benefits that aligns with your experience and market standards.Application
If you can see yourself in the role as a Business Support Specialist at MU, we look forward to receiving your application and CV. If you have questions about the position, you are warmly welcome to contact +32 (0)2 715 09 99.

Your role

As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in transforming innovative machine concepts into reliable, high-performance electrical systems. Acting as the technical owner of the electrical design, you will bridge project requirements and practical implementation, ensuring that every machine is engineered according to the highest quality and safety standards.

Your responsibilities

Electrical design and project planning

• Starting from the conceptual phase, you will participate in the project design meetings where you will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
• You create realistic project schedules and contribute to the collaborative planning meetings in order to create a realistic project planning.
• After the concept phase, you will take ownership of the electrical descriptions: you will translate the draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear and detailed guidelines for the electrical hardware design of the project.
• Based on these electrical descriptions, you will design and adjust the electrical drawings (Eplan P8).
• You will design the 3D electrical layouts in Eplan Propanel.
• You ensure all designs comply with the applicable standards and regulations (EN60204, MD, EMC, LVD, ...).
Execution and collaboration

• Once the design is finished, you create and update ERP work orders for the customer-specific projects and the masters for standard machines.
• During the assembly process you will follow up closely with production.
• As a senior, you will also develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices and ensure all designs comply with the applicable standards.
• You will support your colleagues when necessary and will collaborate with them to review schematics for accuracy.
• You contribute actively to departmental standardization initiatives and gradually take ownership of driving these improvements forward. 
Your profile

• You have a Masters degree in industrial sciences in Electromechanics or Electrotechnics or are equivalent by experience.
• You have at least 5 years of experience in Electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building industry.
• This means you have a solid knowledge of electrical standards. Knowledge of UL standards is a plus.
• You have good knowledge of Eplan P8. Knowledge of Eplan Propanel is a plus.
• You have an analytical mind and are a problem solver.
• You're a good communicator and a team player in an international environment.
• You have a good knowledge of English and Dutch. 
Our offer

• We offer you a challenging job in an international, collaborative and growth-oriented working environment.
• A technical engineering role with opportunities to lead improvement initiatives and to have an impact.
• A competitive compensation package complemented by attractive benefits such as a company car.

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager / Business Development Manager Biometrics
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
   
• Identify, develop and win new strategic accounts within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, building relationships from initial prospecting through to contract award.  
• Own and develop a portfolio of key accounts, establishing account strategies, identifying growth opportunities and increasing share of wallet.  
• Build and maintain strong, multi-level relationships with key decision-makers, including Clinical Operations, Biometrics, Data Management, Statistics, Procurement and R&D stakeholders.  
• Develop a deep understanding of customer strategies, pipelines and outsourcing models to anticipate needs and position relevant SGS solutions proactively.  
• Drive new opportunities and expansion within existing accounts,  
• Lead strategic customer engagements, RFPs, negotiations and commercial discussions through to successful contract closure.  
• Develop and execute account plans and business development strategies, including target identification, opportunity qualification, pipeline development and revenue forecasting.  
• Actively build your network through industry events, conferences, professional networks and targeted business development activities.  
• Work closely with internal Clinical Research, Biometrics and commercial teams to develop tailored solutions and competitive value propositions.  
• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring customer priorities are understood and reflected in proposals, delivery models and commercial strategies.  
• Establish strong internal stakeholder relationships and coordinate cross-functional teams around strategic opportunities and key accounts.  
• Maintain a high level of market intelligence, including competitor activity, outsourcing trends, pricing and customer priorities.  
• Ensure accurate and proactive management of opportunities, account plans and customer intelligence in the CRM system.  
• Contribute to the development of the Biometrics commercial strategy and identify new market segments, services and partnership opportunities. 

Your profile
   
• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Business or an equivalent field.  
• You have 8+ years of relevant commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research or CRO industry, ideally combining new business development and strategic account management.  
• You have a proven track record of winning new business and growing strategic accounts, preferably within CRO, Biometrics, Data Management, Biostatistics or related clinical development services.  
• You have a strong understanding of the clinical drug development process and the role of Biometrics throughout clinical development.  
• You are commercially driven and comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across Clinical Operations, Biometrics, R&D, Procurement and executive management.  
• You have demonstrated experience managing complex sales cycles, strategic RFPs, negotiations and multi-stakeholder decision processes.  
• You are a strong hunter and relationship builder, able to open new accounts while developing long-term strategic partnerships.  
• You combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to prospecting, opportunity development and account execution.  
• You are highly networked within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry and comfortable representing the organization at conferences and industry events.  
• You have excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.  
• You are fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
